organization.short_description:
Informa plc is a prominent British multinational group based in London, specializing in business intelligence, academic publishing, global events, and digital services. The company is publicly traded on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index, with a market capitalization exceeding £3.3 billion. Informa employs around 14,000 people across 30 countries and operates from over 150 office locations worldwide.

Informa's operations are organized into five main divisions. Taylor & Francis focuses on academic publishing, offering journals, books, and reference materials across various disciplines. Informa Markets is a leader in organizing trade shows and conferences in sectors like pharmaceuticals and fashion. Informa Connect provides business intelligence and training, while Informa Festivals creates networking opportunities through conferences. Informa TechTarget targets technology professionals with buyer intent platforms and audience development services. The company serves a diverse range of industries, including life sciences, finance, and technology, helping clients connect and make informed decisions.
